system_under_test.name: Studio OS memory v1 (ADR-527)
system_under_test.index: fresh build in scratch via SPA_MEMORY_INDEX (2249 files / 20429 chunks, build 5.5 s)
system_under_test.call: assembler.assemble(q, budget_chars=12000, measure_host=False) in-process; CLI cold start ≈0.96 s

comparator.name: MemPalace 3.10.0 (embeddinggemma, multilingual)
comparator.how: pre-existing isolated venv + palace built 2026-10-01 by the ADR-527 review session (scratch 4a80058d…/mempalace-eval), copied to this scratch, HOME isolated, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; nothing installed
comparator.caveat: its corpus snapshot is 2026-10-01 — questions whose expected sources are newer are excluded from the fair subset; MemPalace scored on retrieval only (expected source basename in top-5)

scoring.dims: correctness, completeness, temporal, supersession, provenance — 0/1/2 each; null = not applicable
scoring.method: automatic regex/fact grading over the assembled JSON package against ground truth verified from files (see each row's ground_truth). correctness=2 iff an expected source is in top-5 (or cited by a matched semantic fact) AND ≥50% key facts present; 1 iff expected source anywhere OR ≥50% facts; trap question H30 scores 2 only if verdict≠SUFFICIENT
scoring.limits: package-level grading (what a model would SEE), not an LLM answer; regex grading can over-credit facts that appear in irrelevant chunks

builtin_benchmark_rerun.cmd: python -m spa_core.studio_os.memory bench (own + heldout phrasings, k=5)
builtin_benchmark_rerun.note: self-authored 12-question set; held-out phrasings were SEEN before tuning (ADR-527 Evidence table says so) — not a clean number

prior_review.verdict: option C — borrow ideas, not a dependency

numbers.mempalace_embeddinggemma: 0.485 / 0.485, build 32 min, 374 MB palace + 796 MB model

rows.question: Какие эксперименты с BTC-движком мы делали раньше и чем они закончились?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-102 (2026-08-20): BTC cycle champion v0.1 accepted as a measurement, implementation NOT started (drawdown does not fit kill-switch); ADR-118 (2026-08-22) separate BTC paper-NAV track — per ADR-525 never installed; earn-defi MVRV BTC Signal Engine (2026-09-04, separate repo); ADR-525 (2026-09-30) Trading Research Engine v0, 138 BTC candidates.

rows.question: What BTC engine experiments did we run before and how did they end?
rows.ground_truth: same as H01

rows.question: Откуда взялась идея индикаторной торговли (Indicator Trading) — MA, RSI, SuperTrend по BTC?
rows.ground_truth: Term 'Indicator Trading' appears nowhere in repos (rg, 0 hits). Closest: ADR-525 (owner directive 2026-09-30) Trading Research Engine v0 — 10 public-domain indicator families × BTC 1h/4h/1D = 138 candidates, because SPA had no directional price engine; earn-defi BTC Signal Engine (MVRV, trend gates) predates it (2026-09-04).

rows.question: Что такое Director OS и какой был замысел?
rows.ground_truth: 'Director OS doctrine (ADR-469)' cited by ADR-492: read-only snapshot/projection-driven mission control. That ADR-469 exists only in off-origin shadow worktree ~/studio-os-scratch/v03 with status DECISION_PROPOSED (2026-09-24); origin ADR-469 is an unrelated 'writer-harm' ADR (number collision). ADR-552 (2026-10-0x) says Director OS web cockpit (com.spa.director_server :8788) is IMPLEMENTED but DUPLICATES the Director, publish frozen since 09-20; Owner Remote/Mission Control v1 supersedes.

rows.question: What is Director OS and what was its intended purpose?
rows.ground_truth: same as H03

rows.question: Какие три домена у владельца: Capital, Studio OS и Earn DeFi Product — кто чем владеет?
rows.ground_truth: No single canonical doc names 'three owner domains'. Pieces: CAPITAL_ARCHITECTURE (ADR-525) capital hierarchy owned by engines not Studio OS; Studio OS/Bridge = owner control plane (ADR-521); Bridge B19.6.12 erratum: 'Earn DeFi product repo does not exist' — every Earn DeFi product task targeted SPA repo; earn-defi.com site lives in SPA landing/, ~/Documents/earn-defi is the BTC engine repo. Domain model therefore UNKNOWN/fragmented.

rows.question: Как соотносятся старые названия стратегий Preserve / Core / Max Yield с Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive?
rows.ground_truth: docs/DEFI_ARCHITECTURE_GAP_AUDIT.md:43 Conservative (alt Preserve) / Balanced (Core) / Aggressive (Max Yield); docs/SITE_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:369-371 recommended mapping Preserve=Conservative etc. Naming is owner-gated (ADR-285 subject 2).

rows.question: How do the old strategy names Preserve, Core and Max Yield map to Conservative, Balanced and Aggressive?
rows.ground_truth: same as H05

rows.question: Действует ли ещё запрет на Sky/sUSDS?
rows.ground_truth: Ban lifted 2026-08-05 as fulfilled (DSPause delay 48h, three RPCs agree), sky_susds WL/0 -> T1, ADR-065; is_gsm_compliant() gate kept.

rows.question: Сколько классов решений раньше было owner-gated и что заменило этот список?
rows.ground_truth: Former list of 14 owner-gated classes replaced 2026-09-09 by ADR-285: three subjects (real money, public numbers/tier naming/legal, irreversible actions); measured 247 owner cards in 55 days.

rows.question: Какой roadmap сейчас канонический и что стало со старыми roadmap-файлами вроде AI1_ROADMAP и EISENHOWER?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-527 (2026-10-01): single roadmap docs/ROADMAP.md; AI1/ATOMIC/FAMILY_FUND/PHASE2/PRODUCT_REDESIGN/EISENHOWER v1,v2/YIELD_STRATEGY marked SUPERSEDED in architecture/memory_truth.json.

rows.question: Which roadmap is canonical now and what happened to the old roadmap files like AI1_ROADMAP and the Eisenhower roadmap?
rows.ground_truth: same as H08

rows.question: Когда начался paper-трек ($100k), какой у него anchor и когда Balanced и Aggressive получили свои треки?
rows.ground_truth: Conservative $100k track anchor 2026-06-22 (CLAUDE.md, STATE.md:12); ADR-125 (2026-08-23) three packages start paper tracks; ADR-292 (2026-09-09) Balanced/Aggressive get real paper tracks instead of accrual by literals.

rows.question: When did the $100k paper track start, what is its anchor date, and when did Balanced and Aggressive get their own tracks?
rows.ground_truth: same as H09

rows.question: Зачем нужен агент tier_curator и читает ли кто-нибудь его отчёт?
rows.ground_truth: tier_curator = advisory mirror without reader; promotion T3->T2 not automated; ADR-041 criteria not implemented (CLAUDE.md facts table 2026-09-11; docs/TIER_LIFECYCLE_AUDIT_2026-09-11.md).

rows.question: Что делает агент com.spa.capital_shadow, когда запускается и что он не имеет права делать?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-556 (2026-10-04) RM-LIVE-01: shadow execution + pilot readiness, agent 09:45, mode SHADOW, AUTO_LIVE does not exist, unsigned intents; DeFi sleeves BLOCKED, rest NOT_READY.

rows.question: Why does com.spa.source_discovery exist and what went wrong with it?
rows.ground_truth: .claude/rules/deployment.md: com.spa.source_discovery failed EVERY run with ModuleNotFoundError spa_core while acceptance was green; ADR-148 (27.08) adds per-agent target load check; target find_defillama_sources.py.

rows.question: Какие крупные инциденты с доставкой и git у нас повторялись (exec-бит, force-push, checkout data)?
rows.ground_truth: .claude/rules/deployment.md: 2026-08-04 sync stripped exec bit 67/69 agents 5h; 2026-08-24 git checkout -- data/ reverted 116 files; 2026-08-29 force-push erased 1249 commits (pre-push hook).

rows.question: Which large delivery and git incidents happened repeatedly (exec bit stripped, force push, checkout of data)?
rows.ground_truth: same as H13

rows.question: Что за утечка PAT была и какое правило по секретам из неё вышло?
rows.ground_truth: Incident 2026-06-10: PAT leaked into 90+ files; invariant #7 no secrets in files, read from Keychain at runtime, no push_*.html; now single token GITHUB_PAT_SPA (expires 2026-11-24).

rows.question: Какую роль владелец задумал для двух Telegram-ботов?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-521 (2026-09-30): Bridge bot com.studiobridge.telegram = Studio OS / owner control plane; SPA bot com.spa.telegram_bot = product surface; paused != down.

rows.question: What role did the owner intend for each of the two Telegram bots?
rows.ground_truth: same as H15

rows.question: Почему кнопки под тревогой в Телеграме писали «Кнопки сейчас недоступны» и как это решили?
rows.ground_truth: CLAUDE.md facts table (2026-09-16): buttons gated by the bot's capability list in beacon, threshold 6h (alert_actions.BEACON_MAX_AGE_S) vs liveness 300s (telegram_health); equating them returned the warning on every restart (ADR-400).

rows.question: В каком порядке ADR-527 выстроил roadmap после памяти?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-527 §8: Memory -> DeFi Architecture Gap Audit -> DeFi Engine vNext -> Build Loop -> Owner Remote/Mission Control -> Capital Allocator/Portfolio CIO -> limited real-capital pilots (owner-gated) -> later engines.

rows.ground_truth: ADR-554 (2026-10-04, owner macro-epic CHIEF INVESTMENT OFFICER / CAPITAL ALLOCATION): Investment CIO, display name 'Oracle' ('Штирлиц' until 2026-10-04), role_id chief_investment_officer, ADVISORY/PAPER cross-sleeve recommendation + immutable ledger (docs/ROADMAP.md:26, architecture/roles.json:7).

rows.ground_truth: docs/TOURNAMENT_VERDICT_AND_6MO_BACKLOG.md (2026-07-10): Conservative ~3.3% / Balanced ~8-12% / Aggressive ~15-20%+. Note TOURNAMENT doc NOT in memory allow-list.

rows.question: Почему не взяли MemPalace для памяти компании?
rows.ground_truth: ADR-527: option C borrow ideas; MemPalace 3.10.0 0.273/0.152 (minilm) and 0.485 (embeddinggemma, 32-min build) vs 0.94/0.85; chromadb+onnxruntime violate stdlib invariant.

rows.question: What are the kill-switch drawdown thresholds and which ADRs set them?
rows.ground_truth: SOFT_DERISK [5%,10%), HARD_KILL >=10% inclusive; ADR-034 + ADR-048.
